messages:
Sophia Nguyen: Heads-up — customer A asked for hard SLAs on p99 and a 'recommendation' tier that prefers lower-cost model variants. Want to sketch where that sits in the Optimize toolkit roadmap.
Jon Chen: Can we treat that as a dedicated policy: econ-tier routing + eval-triggered alerts?
Li Wei: +1. We should also provide quantization recs per workload (latency-sensitive vs quality-sensitive). Suggest we add a minimal heuristic table.
Chris O'Neill: For prioritization, we need clear launch gates. What are the MUST-haves vs NICE-to-haves for Q3 pilot?
Maya Patel: From sales: MUST = per-route cost telemetry, basic model variant routing, and eval alerting for regression > 5% on key prompt set. NICE = autosuggested quant levels, per-tenant cache controls.
Sophia Nguyen: Ok: provisional gates: (1) policy routing MVP (rule-based), (2) eval-alert integration with console + webhook, (3) token-level cost breakdown per model variant. If any of these missing -> no pilot.
Jon Chen: Implementation notes: routing MVP can use existing smart routing hooks. Eval alerts: wire to existing eval-sentry infra. Webhook format: {"alert":"regression","threshold":0.05}
Li Wei: On recommendations: propose two profiles — "latency" (aggressive quant + prefix cache) and "quality" (no quant except fp16). Provide a quick command:
```
# sample rec CLI
ri optimize recommend --profile latency --workload chat --p95_target 200ms
```
Chris O'Neill: How do we measure customer impact for the gate? Need an acceptance metric. Maybe: pilot customers show >=20% token-cost reduction with <3% quality delta on eval set.
Maya Patel: Sales will only sign pilots if we commit to rollback policy and SLA fallback to hosted model. Add that to canary rollback docs.
Sophia Nguyen: Scope negotiation: compress NICE features into post-pilot backlog. Pilot MVP timeline = 6 weeks from kick. Who owns rollout docs and runbook?
Jon Chen: I'll own runbook + routing docs. I'll add canary rollback patterns.
Li Wei: I'll draft recommendation heuristics and quant profiles. Will include sample eval prompts.
Chris O'Neill: I'll draft acceptance metrics + experiment plan for 3 pilot customers.
Maya Patel: I'll line up the pilot customers and compile the contract asks (SLA + rollback language).
ops-bot: Deployment reminder — infra freeze window next Thursday 00:00-06:00 UTC. Plan canaries outside that window. :warning:
Sophia Nguyen: Next steps: owners post-initial drafts by EOD Friday. Quick sync Wednesday 10am PT to finalize gates. If anyone needs scope trimmed, call it out in this thread today. :thumbsup:
